name: secure-vault-electron
description: Desktop manager for SecureVault — connects to ESP32-S3 over USB CDC serial with ECDH + AES-256-GCM (4-Layer Security Stack). No HTTP, no network stack — direct USB serial only. Tray-mode + .svlt file watcher for two-way sync with the browser extension.

scripts.postinstall: echo 'SecureVault Electron v5.2 installed. Run: npm start'
